After countless trips to different groomers who never quite get it right—my Goldendoodle, Boogie, either came back too short or looking like his coat was hacked with a dull knife—we finally hit the jackpot. Today we went to Woof Cutz, and to say I’m thrilled is an understatement. They understood the assignment perfectly! Boogie looks absolutely amazing—his coat is even, soft, and just the right length. We’ve finally found our grooming home, and I couldn’t recommend Woof Cutz more highly!

Waste of money and time. Appointment 02/11/25 and he’s getting ANOTHER HAIR CUT TODAY 02/25/25 somewhere else, it’s been two weeks ! They snoozed on a returning customer. Trying to find a decent groomer after trying some in the area- none stuck out. This one, unfortunately stuck out for the worst. As a customer, introduction and friendliness go a long way, from one young person to the next. The vibe was very off as soon as we walked in. Heavy. No warm welcoming. Now, off-bat, we tried to brush it off. They did ask us if we had a certain cut in mind- we said not particularly but yk, he does need a polish up. He’s got an out grown coat (of a Pomeranian), needed nails clipped, toe-bean hair trim. I didn’t think I had to verbally tell them that- that’s what the service should be. Without a second thought, we all felt the same vibe without even needing to discuss what odd interaction that was. His haircut was scheduled at 11, they said it’ll be 4 hours. Great. We were running errands, and handling family issues at the hospital- when I get a text at 2:15 that my dog was ready. And that they were CLOSING at 2:30. Giving me 15 minutes to get there and pick up my dog. No consideration of a customers time- no effective communication that they were closing at 2:30 in the afternoon, upon arrival, there was no apology of the miscommunication, I got there ten minutes after 2:30 with speeding thru traffic. When we were in there picking him up, there was another women there to drop off- and the same groomer, greeted her , talked to her pooch, smiles and giggles. Mind you, this was TWO WEEKS AGO! We JUST NOW dropped him off at another groomer in highland- LITERALLY night and freakin day. They immediately said hello to us, greeted our dog WITH ENTHUSIASM , it was upbeat and colorful inside, THEYYY held a great conversation about our dog and THEY led the conversation. Without asking, they told us about their packages, their hours, how long he would take (by the way, only 2 hours, MAX, she said !), they had little care packages for him when we go to pick him up, just all around what we were expecting at first. We support small businesses, so when you can’t give a smile and a good effort of your own business, I wish you luck and prosperity- but ultimately we’ll take him where we feel he’s safe.
